sections.title: State Overview
paragraphs:
Paraná is located in the South region of Brazil with its capital in Curitiba.
With a population of 11,800,000, Paraná offers a unique blend of
opportunities and lifestyle experiences. The state is characterized by its Agriculture, Agribusiness, Manufacturing, Services
and is known for being Professionals and families.

sections.title: Economy & Employment
paragraphs:
Paraná's economy is built on Agriculture, Agribusiness, Manufacturing, Services. The state offers significant opportunities
for both local and international professionals seeking employment and business ventures.

Employment Outlook:
Paraná presents strong opportunities across multiple sectors,
with salaries ranging from R$ 3,200-7,000 average monthly salary for average positions.

sections.title: Education & Universities
paragraphs:
Paraná boasts several excellent universities and educational institutions, making it ideal for
students and families seeking quality education.

Education Options:
From public universities to private institutions, Paraná offers
diverse educational opportunities. Many universities offer programs in English for international students.
